$description: Power-outage discard rules for FoodKeeper products, curated from USDA FSIS 'Power Outages & Food Safety'. FoodKeeper itself holds shelf-life data, not outage rules; this file maps products to the USDA outage lists. Rules are evaluated top to bottom, first match wins. A product matched by no rule is treated as a perishable and flagged as unlisted (fail closed). Safe classes are an explicit allowlist: every one cites a named USDA list item.

source.title: Power Outages & Food Safety
source.publisher: USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service

fallback.usdaItem: Not named in USDA's outage lists. Treated like a perishable: when in doubt, throw it out.

rules.usdaItem: Opened mayonnaise, tartar sauce and horseradish: discard if held above 50 F for over 8 hours.
Garlic stored in oil: discard after 4 hours without power.
Gravy and stuffing; creamy-based salad dressings: discard after 4 hours without power.
Whole fresh fruits and vegetables do not require refrigeration.
rules.caveat: Whole, uncut produce only. Cut fruit and vegetables are discarded after 4 hours.

rules.usdaItem: Fresh herbs and spices, and flour, do not require refrigeration.
Dried fruits and nuts do not require refrigeration or freezing.
Butter and margarine do not require refrigeration or freezing.
Hard and processed cheeses do not require refrigeration or freezing.
Baked goods such as bread, rolls, muffins and fruit pies do not require refrigeration or freezing.
rules.caveat: Not for items with cream cheese frosting or cream fillings.

rules.usdaItem: High-acid foods such as mustard, ketchup, relishes, pickles, non-creamy salad dressings, jams and jellies are safe to use, though they may spoil sooner.
Raw, cooked or leftover meat, poultry, fish and eggs; luncheon meat and hot dogs: discard after 4 hours without power.
Eggs and egg substitutes: discard after 4 hours without power.
Milk, cream, yogurt, sour cream and soft cheeses: discard after 4 hours without power.
Casseroles, soups, stews, pizza, mixed salads, cooked vegetables, cut fruit and leftovers: discard after 4 hours without power.
Batters and doughs: discard after 4 hours without power.
Custard, chiffon or cheese pies and cream-filled pastries: discard after 4 hours without power.
